header: OCCUPANCY AND ADDITIONAL GUEST AGREEMENT — SHORT TERM RENTAL

blocks.text: Attached to the Short Term Rental Agreement dated {{agreement_date}} between {{host_name}} ("Host") and {{guest_name}} ("Guest").
The following individuals are registered as guests for this stay. Each registered guest is bound by the Short Term Rental Agreement and all addenda:

rows: Including children and infants. Infants under {{infant_age_threshold}} months count toward the limit.
Maximum total persons at any one time
Includes overnight guests and daytime visitors combined.

blocks.text: If Guest wishes to have additional persons stay overnight beyond the registered guest list:

items: Guest must request approval from Host at least {{additional_guest_request_days}} days before the additional guest's arrival.
Host approval is required in writing (email, Platform message, or signed addendum).
Additional guests must be added to the registered guest list and must sign the Short Term Rental Agreement or an acknowledgment addendum.
Each additional overnight guest incurs a fee of {{additional_guest_fee}} per night.
Additional guests are subject to all the same rules and obligations as the original registered guests.
If Host does not approve the additional guest, the additional guest may not stay at the property.
If an unapproved guest stays at the property, Host may:
Charge an unauthorized guest fee of {{unauthorized_guest_fee}} per night.
Terminate the stay immediately without refund.
Contact law enforcement if the unapproved guest refuses to leave.
Day visitors (non-overnight) are limited to {{max_day_visitors}} at any one time.
Day visitors are not registered and are not bound by the Short Term Rental Agreement, but Guest remains responsible for their conduct.
Day visitors may not use the property in a manner that violates house rules, disturbs neighbors, or exceeds occupancy limits.
If day visitors cause damage, Host will charge Guest for all resulting costs.

blocks.text: Occupancy limit violations are among the most common causes of STR disputes, neighbor complaints, and insurance claim denials. Host takes occupancy violations seriously:

items: If Host or HOA discovers unregistered guests, Host will first attempt to contact the lead guest.
If the violation is not resolved within 1 hour, Host may terminate the stay without refund.
Repeated violations may result in Guest being banned from future bookings.

blocks.text: Guest acknowledges the occupancy limits and additional guest policy. Guest agrees to register all guests and to ensure all persons at the property comply with the Short Term Rental Agreement.
